runners.name: Phase 5 Coexistence & Integration Spec
keyChecks: Coexistence of 3 signature heroes + 9 legacy heroes + 4 enemies + 3 map assets without state collision

G-01.name: 19 Assets Load & Classification
G-01.requirement: Load, clone, and inspect all 19 assets (12 heroes, 4 enemies, 3 map assets) with accurate fallback
G-01.passCriteria: All 19 models exist, have valid BasePart counts (1676 total), map models marked N/A

G-02.name: Joint & Visible Limb Mobility
G-02.requirement: Expected semantic joints (6 or 9) move visible limbs and weapons in World CFrame after engine step with zero rigid lock
G-02.passCriteria: Children parts unanchored, Motor6D C0 updates produce non-zero world CFrame delta on limb parts

G-03.name: Accessory Attachment Invariants
G-03.requirement: Accessories (Straw Hat, 3 swords, Cowboy Hat, beads) follow parent limb across all 8 states
G-03.passCriteria: WeldConstraint/Attachment positions maintain relative offset to parent bone < 0.001

G-04.name: Deterministic Transport Controls
G-04.requirement: Pause, seek, cancel, reset, scale, and replay restore exact rest pose with zero cumulative drift
G-04.passCriteria: delta < 0.001 between initial rest pose snapshot and post-scrub reset pose

G-05.name: VFX Cue & Layer Quality
G-05.requirement: VFX cues fire at proper positions, layer toggles respected, quality caps enforced, seek does not re-emit cues
G-05.passCriteria: Instance caps (Low:8, Med:16, High:30) never exceeded, zero duplicate cues on scrub

G-06.name: Combat Oracle Invariance
G-06.requirement: 0.31s nominal hit timing, damage cadence, RNG, armor, splash, slow, and sell semantics never altered by visual errors or toggles
G-06.passCriteria: Independent server timer fires damage at t = 0.31s regardless of visual state, sell cancels pending hit

G-07.name: Resource Ledger 100% Cleanup
G-07.requirement: Destroy, sell, reset, or close leaves zero orphaned instances, tweens, tasks, or connections; ledger equals subtree count
G-07.passCriteria: Active tracked instances = 0 and workspace container child count = 0 after cleanupAllForModel

G-08.name: Sandbox & Production Isolation
G-08.requirement: Animation Lab sandbox and production guard never alter gameplay, economy, wave progress, or player rewards
G-08.passCriteria: RunService:IsStudio() guards all remotes/UI; dummy targets do not register with WaveManager

G-09.name: Multi-Character Coexistence
G-09.requirement: Mixed characters (Luffy, Zoro, Ace + 16 legacy) do not collide or overwrite RigContext or VFXExecutionContext
G-09.passCriteria: Concurrent execution of 19 instances operates independently without shared state corruption

G-10.name: Stress & Telemetry Benchmarks
G-10.requirement: Measured stress testing at 1, 10, 25, and 50 active characters with documented hardware, frame time, and memory
G-10.passCriteria: Empirical metrics recorded with device/build/quality; pending budgets truthfully flagged

G-11.name: Full Regression Suite Pass
G-11.requirement: Existing Phase 1-4 tests (node tests/run_all_tests.mjs) pass 44/44 without degradation or reduced assertions

G-12.name: Interactive Studio GUI Acceptance
G-12.requirement: Visual acceptance of Luffy, Zoro, Ace, and Animation Lab UI in interactive Roblox Studio
G-12.passCriteria: If run headless without interactive Studio GUI, truthfully record as NOT VERIFIED (Awaiting Interactive Studio GUI Inspection)

G-13.name: Scope & Documentation Compliance
G-13.requirement: Final diff and all documentation changes strictly within approved Phase 5 boundaries with zero scope drift
G-13.passCriteria: Protected paths (AGENTS.md, CONVENTIONS.md, GameConfig.luau, Track1, Track3) untouched in git history
